Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Sunita - 57 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Manoj stands on the road. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Manoj is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Manoj: "Mom, look at this."

[Manoj steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Sunita: "Good job, Manoj!"

[Manoj is killed when a truck hits him.]

Sunita: "No… this cannot be!"
